summary: Diagnose broken learning before spending more compute on architecture changes.
outcomes: Use tiny-batch overfitting and gradient checks
Distinguish optimization failures from generalization failures
sequence: Inspect loss, gradients and activation scales
Repeat a controlled change and report variance

visual.question: Which symptom points to bad data, broken gradients or overfitting?
visual.interaction: Inject one failure at a time into a tiny training trace

practice.task: Diagnose three deliberately broken training runs
practice.success: Each diagnosis cites evidence and a minimal experiment that distinguishes alternatives
